blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The International Criminal Court (ICC) sets the trial schedule for former President Rodrigo Duterte on his alleged crimes against humanity charges up until April next year. READ: Rodrigo Duterte camp tells ICC no crimes against humanity in PH Duterte’s trial, which will first see the presentation of prosecution evidence, will begin on Nov. 30 and will continue until the court’s judicial recess on Dec. 18, according to the ICC Trial Chamber III order dated Nov. 26.
